title: Expose paginated completion timeline through CLI and API
description: Add project.timeline, heist timeline and the project-scoped HTTP timeline route. Return deterministic order, bounded rows, inclusive time filters and stale-page detection. Timeline includes done only until cancellation dates have a defined model.
why: Deliver the reviewed roadmap plan without regressions in existing project workflows.

acceptance.text: CLI and HTTP match public API row shapes
Invalid filters and stale pagination fail clearly
Recorded and legacy fallback dates are distinguishable

outcome.summary: Added deterministic, bounded timeline pages to public API, CLI and HTTP with inclusive ISO date bounds and stale-snapshot handling.
outcome.verifiedBy: Windows Node 24: npm run check 91 passed, 1 opt-in real-model test skipped; final roadmap tests 14/14; TypeScript declarations 0 diagnostics; browser verification at 1280x850 and 320x740; 2000-ticket benchmark warm timeline 22ms, structure 82ms.
